data_description: The input data consists of OOP-related compiler bug records collected from the C++ components of GCC and LLVM.
use_case: Analyzing OOP-related compiler bugs by jointly inspecting bug reports and their corresponding patches, and then characterizing the OOP features involved in the bugs (and how they are fixed). This enables constructing a taxonomy of OOP-related features leading to compiler bugs and supports deeper understanding of the characteristics of OOP-related bugs in C++ compilers.
